## Conclusion 1

Why: Large spread cells/nuclei with intact tubulin-actin and top atlas match to DNA replication reference.

Next experiment if this were a real lab: Pulse-EdU incorporation plus DNA-content flow and gamma-H2AX/p-H3 immunofluorescence to test S-phase inhibition vs DNA breaks vs Aurora polyploidy.

## Conclusion 2

**DNA replication** (stated probability 0.42); key evidence e2, e3, e4, e13, e14.

Why: Could not acquire 10uM: budget 0. Per-dose atlas split; DNA content/multinucleation flat argues against Aurora but binucleation remains uncertain.

Next experiment if this were a real lab: Acquire 10uM rep1 for dose_response of DNA content/multinucleation plus EdU/gamma-H2AX/p-H3 staining to separate S-phase block vs Aurora polyploidy.

## PI review

Verdict: request experiment.

Does not favour top MoA over runner-up: atlas is split (Aurora 5/10 neighbours, DNA replication 3/10 only; top-hit for DNA replication but mixed). Phenotype is contradictory (mitotic binucleation at 3uM suggests Aurora, but frac_multinucleate_proxy z=-3.77, nuc_dna_integrated ~0). Both doses are single-well (rep 1 only), dose-response for DNA content/mitotic fraction could not be computed, so p=0.58 for DNA replication over Aurora/DNA damage is not calibrated. A specific affordable acquisition could discriminate: acquire dose index 5 (10.0 uM) rep 1 as a third dose/replicate for dose_response on nuc_dna_integrated, frac_large_nucleus and frac_multinucleate_proxy (Aurora: increasing integrated DNA/multinucleation with dose; DNA replication: large nuclei/cells without ploidy increase).

Requested: acquire dose_index 5 (10.0 uM), rep 1

## Unblinding

Compound: **floxuridine** (PubChem CID [5790](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/5790))

Identity check: name and BBBC021 structure agree

ChEMBL mechanisms: Thymidylate synthase inhibitor

## Verdict (computed by code)

Correct: agent said **DNA replication**, BBBC021 annotates **DNA replication**.

## Reflection

The DNA replication call was correct for unblinded floxuridine, a thymidylate synthase inhibitor (PMID 1532343; PMID 3155521). The decisive evidence was extreme large-nucleus enrichment (frac_large_nucleus z=+17.5 at 3 uM) with spread enlarged cells (cell_area z=+9.8 to +14.1) and microscopist-noted lower density with intact tubulin-actin, plus the 30 uM per-dose atlas favoring DNA replication (6/10) over DNA damage and microtubule destabilizers.
The confidence was not calibrated and the Aurora runner-up was not excluded. The mid-dose microscopist explicitly suggested Aurora kinase inhibitors based on binucleation, the pooled atlas favored Aurora 5/10 vs DNA replication 3/10, and the 3 uM per-dose atlas favored Aurora 6/10. I noted flat integrated DNA (~0) and frac_multinucleate_proxy z=-3.77 as against polyploidy, but from single wells only.
The root cause was acquisition choice: spending the 2-well budget on 3 uM and 30 uM rep 1 only meant all dose_response calls failed for need of at least 3 wells, so no dose trend for nuc_dna_integrated, frac_large_nucleus or multinucleation could separate S-phase block without ploidy increase from Aurora dose-dependent polyploidy, exactly the reviewer's requested 10.0 uM rep 1 experiment.

What was right:
- Massive frac_large_nucleus and cell_area/cell_major_axis enlargement with lower density pointed to replication stress / megaloblastic-like arrest rather than cytoskeletal collapse
- High-dose 30 uM atlas match favoring DNA replication (6/10) and intact tubulin-actin description correctly down-weighted microtubule stabilizer/destabilizer and actin disruptor hypotheses
- Keeping DNA replication above Aurora despite split atlas because integrated DNA and multinucleation proxy did not rise as expected for Aurora polyploidy

What was wrong or missed:
- p=0.58 (then 0.42) for DNA replication over Aurora/DNA damage was overconfident given pooled atlas 5/10 Aurora and explicit microscopist Aurora call at 3 uM for binucleation
- Left contradictory binucleation visual vs negative multinucleate proxy and ~0 nuc_dna_integrated unresolved with only single-well rep 1 per dose and no replicate
- Acquired only 2 wells (3 uM and 30 uM) so dose_response for cell_area, nuc_area, cell_count and nuc_dna_integrated all failed, missing the discriminative 10 uM third dose requested in review

Proposed next experiment: Pulse-EdU incorporation with DNA-content flow plus gamma-H2AX and phospho-H3 immunofluorescence across 3, 10 and 30 uM to test S-phase block (EdU-low without ploidy increase) versus Aurora polyploidy versus DNA damage.

## Citations

Citations verified: 3/3

- PMID [1532343](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/1532343/): Radiosensitization by fluorodeoxyuridine: effects of thymidylate synthase inhibition and cell synchronization. *Cancer Res* (1992) — Fluorodeoxyuridine acts via thymidylate synthase inhibition affecting cell synchronization.
- PMID [3155521](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/3155521/): Regulation of thymidylate synthase enzyme synthesis in 5-fluorodeoxyuridine-resistant mouse fibroblasts during the transition from the resting to growing state. *J Cell Physiol* (1985) — Cellular response and resistance to 5-fluorodeoxyuridine involves regulation of thymidylate synthase synthesis.
- PMID [6450011](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/6450011/): Drug-induced megaloblastic change. *Clin Haematol* (1980) — Perturbed DNA synthesis can produce megaloblastic enlarged nucleus/cell changes consistent with the large-nucleus phenotype.
